documents.markdown:
# Geul design system in Storybook

Storybook contains the system rules, component contracts and page documentation alongside
running production Core controls and Feature views. The application and Storybook share
`DesignSystemProvider`, locale messages and generated token CSS. Fixture state resets on remount.

Tokens in `@echovisionlab/design-system/tokens`, `theme.ts` and Core source own the adopted
contracts. Storybook presents those contracts and the evidence needed to review them.
The [system guide](./design-system.md), [component documentation](./design-system/component-documentation.md)
and [page documentation](./design-system/page-documentation.md) define the documentation requirements.
Use the Docs tab for purpose, API, supported states, content, responsive behavior and
accessibility contracts; use the Canvas tab to exercise the actual implementation.
Docs and previews must link to the same source owner and consumers.

## Run

From `geul-web`, run `pnpm storybook` on port 6010. To use another port, run
`pnpm storybook --port <port>` and use that origin for preview and test commands.
For a static build, run `pnpm storybook:build`, then `pnpm storybook:preview`.
The preview server defaults to port 6010; `UI_KIT_PORT` overrides it.
Build output and tool caches are disposable and are regenerated when needed.

## Inspect

Start at **Foundations / Overview** for the system rules and generated catalog.
Read the relevant foundation and component documentation before changing a page.
Use the Theme and Locale toolbar controls and the Phone, Tablet or Desktop viewports.
Use Controls for fixture states; Reload story resets edits.

The sidebar has six roots: Design System, Foundations, Core, Composition, Feature and Pages.
Design System contains the handbook, component/page catalogs, usage comparisons and pattern documentation.
Core and Feature use `root / category or domain / component`; Pages uses
`Pages / area / view`, with complete editor previews grouped under `Pages / Editors`.
Foundations and Composition list their subjects directly. Each subject has one story
file and one title. Fixed states and interactive playgrounds are named examples within
that entry, rather than separate `States`, `Interactive` or `Contracts` folders.

Component stories live beside their source in `components/core` or `features`.
Cross-component examples live in `stories/foundations`, `stories/compositions`,
`stories/features` and `stories/pages`; their shared fixture adapters live in
`stories/shared`. `check-story-catalog.mjs`, included in `design-system:check`, rejects
duplicate titles, repeated path segments, unnecessary nesting and broken fixture links.
Story URLs follow these titles; regenerate the inventory after renaming an entry.

[Generated inventory](./design-system/generated-inventory.md) lists current source owners and stories.
[Route coverage](./design-system/route-preview-coverage.md) records each preview's scope.
[Page coverage](./design-system/page-preview-coverage.md) tracks public pages and query-selected
editor branches separately. [Feature coverage](./design-system/feature-preview-index.md) lists view-level coverage.

The [accessibility release readiness matrix](./design-system/release-readiness.md) defines
the ordered review of all actual pages, conditional views, Core families and feature kinds.
It preserves current visual design and displayed wording; a preview mapping is not a completed check.

## Loading review

Read the [common loading contract](./design-system/loading-surface-contract.md) and
[consumer migration](./design-system/migrations/loading-commonization.md) before reviewing a wait.
Use these source-backed entries to compare the shared presentation with actual consumers:

| Entry                                                                                                                                                                    | Review scope                                                                                                                                               |
| ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| [Core/Feedback/PageLoaderView](../components/core/LoadingSurface/PageLoaderView.stories.tsx)                                                                             | Required visible text, failed image and `FlowRegion` with content before/after the wait                                                                    |
| [Feature/Site/PageLoader](../features/site/PageLoader/PageLoader.stories.tsx)                                                                                            | Manifest fixture, generic/phase text, no image, failed image and placement Controls                                                                        |
| [Foundations/Catalogue Boundary](../stories/foundations/CatalogueBoundary.stories.tsx)                                                                                   | Bootstrap pending, configured image, failed image and retry before ManifestProvider                                                                        |
| [Feature/Page/Block Loading](../features/page/blocks/BlockLoading.stories.tsx)                                                                                           | Grid/list, authors, map and table region geometry                                                                                                          |
| [Feature/Data Table/Server Navigation Wait](../features/data-table/ServerDataTable/ServerDataTablePending.stories.tsx)                                                   | Filter/sort/page navigation, error recovery and retained rows with a manually settled local Promise                                                        |
| [Core/Actions/TextButton](../components/core/TextButton/TextButton.stories.tsx), [Core/Data Display/TableRowMenu](../components/core/DataTable/TableRowMenu.stories.tsx) | Controlled command pending and returned-Promise tracking                                                                                                   |
| [Core/Input/MultiSelectComboboxView](../components/core/Input/MultiSelectComboboxView.stories.tsx)                                                                       | `Loading`, `LoadingEmpty`, `Creating`, `DisabledPending`, `CreationRetry`: checking feedback, retained selection and creation gating                       |
| [Core/Overlays/ConfirmModal](../components/core/Modal/ConfirmModal.stories.tsx)                                                                                          | `QueuedConfirmation` uses eager loading with required localized `loadError`; `RendererLoadError` renders the actual recovery view with local no-op actions |
| [Feature/Auth/Login Flow](../features/auth/LoginFlowView.stories.tsx), [Feature/Auth/Verification Flow View](../features/auth/ui/VerificationFlowView.stories.tsx)       | Retained PIN submission, isolated resend pending, retained applying/unavailable result during authority rechecks                                           |
| [Feature/Page/Tool Startup](../features/page/blocks/embed/ToolStartup.stories.tsx)                                                                                       | Production PageContentView/EmbedFrame/ToolModule pending, failed, ready and `Mobile` 320px region; local external mount fixture, real site loader          |
| [Feature/User/ProfileAvatarControl](../features/user/ui/ProfileAvatarControl/ProfileAvatarControl.stories.tsx)                                                           | Image removal at profile/admin sizes, disabled state, shared media-overlay glyph and pending treatment                                                     |

The loader image fixtures default to static local images; failed-image examples request a missing local GIF.
Use loader Controls with the observed public GIF to inspect delivery and playback. A supplied map
`rendering` phase demonstrates supported copy, not an observed runtime transition.
Check containing regions, retained content, error/retry, focus, theme, locale and viewport separately.
Normal Storybook preview preloads on-demand overlays, so it cannot by itself establish cold-chunk
feedback or exhausted host retries. Tool startup fixtures control the module's `mount()` Promise;
they do not delay module download or contact real tool services. Server navigation retains existing
rows by default; an empty pending table can still use PageLoader.

The coordinator reports direct visual inspection of the actual Works GIF and live PortaDJ ready
state. Storybook observations cover common-loader GIF phase/generic text, no-image/failed-image
cases, tool pending/failed/ready and the 320px region, and the `33steps` avatar plus hover.
This documentation pass did not run browser checks. Most other production/Storybook states,
physical coarse-pointer input and actual assistive-technology announcements remain unverified.
Source links and play functions are review locations, not execution results. These observations
record no released web version or blanket visual approval.

## Editor pages

`Pages` includes Post, Page, Work, Artist, Label, Release, Program Event, Program Event Series,
Form Builder, Terms and Privacy editor previews, plus the Campaign editor.
Document editor fixtures use local canonical Yjs documents and a provider with networking disabled.
They render the production editor views, with local metadata and connection/permission states.

These previews cover layout and local editing. Uploads, relation management, authorization,
server persistence and route loading require application verification. The Form preview covers
the builder; settings, submissions and translations have separate coverage requirements.

Service-backed authoring extensions without local adapters are omitted from the composed
editor previews through `AuthoringExtensionsProvider`. Production editors enable these
extensions by default and retain their permission checks. Dedicated view stories with local
callbacks still cover sharing, uploads and translation controls. OG configuration previews
retain local save/reset controls and omit the unavailable generation service. Place previews
use editable names, addresses and coordinates without loading external map services.
Storybook route navigation
opens existing catalog entries and retains Theme and Locale selections.

## Validate

Run `pnpm storybook:typecheck` and `pnpm design-system:check` after source changes.
Generate the current catalog with `node scripts/design-system/inventory.mjs`,
then `node scripts/design-system/page-preview-coverage.mjs` and
`node scripts/design-system/feature-preview-index.mjs`.
The [toolbar guard](./design-system/storybook-toolbar-guard.md) documents shared locale/theme ownership.

Use `node scripts/design-system/review.mjs run compact-product` for the saved product review plan.
`status compact-product` reads the current checks; `record compact-product` publishes passing,
current evidence after the manual notes are updated. See the [review tooling guide](./design-system/review-tools.md).
Plans live in `design/storybook/review-plans/`; execution outputs use the stable ignored
`.artifacts/design-system/reviews/<name>/` directory. Reuse this tool instead of recreating temporary scripts.

## File browser verification

The [file browser guide](./design-system/file-browser.md) defines Core sizing and selection
contracts, navigation roots and the current API role policy. Core Selection Surface stories
cover automatic, explicit and responsive column counts. Editor File Library Picker form stories
use real form fields and show reports only on Add and Submit. Verify both grid and list in Phone,
Tablet and Desktop viewports, themes and locales before changing consuming screens.

File browser review includes independent icon sizing, fractional grid cells and the shared View settings popover. See [file browser contracts](./design-system/file-browser.md) for OS references, selection/navigation rules and consent-aware local persistence.

File browser Core examples use the same file appearance as the production grid: Grid Columns combines automatic/fixed/responsive controls in one story, and File Icons covers file types. Folder Navigation shows matching parent/view
action sizes and a scoped root without an up action. Native Range covers automatic, explicit and
disabled slider values. The guide's ownership table links each definition to its consumers.

File lists in File Manager and Editor File Library Picker share `FileBrowserListView` and Core `DataTableView.mobileLayout="inline"`: one vertically centered row, trailing short format/size, filename ellipsis, and size-only metadata below the container `sm` breakpoint. See [the file browser contract](./design-system/file-browser.md).

Collection and table controls share Core `ToolbarLayout`; `SelectionToolbar` and both DataTable toolbar adapters consume it. Search/filter inputs inherit compact density. Table selection geometry is Core-owned. See [tables and toolbars](./design-system/tables-and-toolbars.md).

documents.title: Live announcement lifecycle
documents.markdown:
# Live announcement lifecycle

Pending actions keep their accessible action name and keyboard focus while preventing
repeat activation. Their progress announcement must also remain named if navigation,
a completed operation or a closed dialog removes the control and its labels.

## Dependency correction

React Aria 3.53.1 creates a live-region image with `aria-labelledby` references to the
original control and progress indicator. The image remains in the document for seven
seconds. Unmounting those sources leaves an unnamed image and dangling references.
The first browser announcement also waits 100 ms, so its labels can disappear before
it enters the live region.

`patches/react-aria@3.53.1.patch` resolves the referenced accessible name at the public
`announce()` boundary while the sources are mounted. It uses
`dom-accessibility-api@0.6.3`, declared for that exact React Aria version in
`pnpm-workspace.yaml`. The name calculation retains nested labels, external ID
references, hidden-name rules and duplicate-reference handling. It is not a copy of
visible `textContent`.

A temporary probe sits outside the live logs and is removed immediately. The actual
announcement keeps its computed name through `aria-label`. Plain string announcements,
assertive/polite urgency, the initial browser delay and the seven-second cleanup are
unchanged. Core action APIs, pending state, focus and duplicate-activation guards are
unchanged. A missing or empty source name still produces an empty name; this correction
does not supply a fallback that hides invalid semantics.

The patch covers the package's CommonJS and both ESM implementations. pnpm records
its content hash in the lockfile and applies it during installation. Recheck this
correction when upgrading React Aria; remove it when the installed upstream version
retains equivalent semantics without dangling references.

## Verification scope

`components/core/Button/PendingAnnouncement.test.tsx` exercises the installed React
Aria implementation through Button and IconButton, external and nested labels,
focused pending state, owner unmount, the initial delay, urgency and timed cleanup.
The regular Button and IconButton tests continue to cover their action behavior.

The current React Aria toast implementation uses mounted alert content rather than
this global pending announcer. `components/core/Notification/Notification.test.tsx`
checks title and description references through dismiss, replacement and queue cleanup.
No Notification production change is required by that regression.

Run these tests after dependency installation:

```sh
node node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run \
  components/core/Button/PendingAnnouncement.test.tsx \
  components/core/Button/Button.test.tsx \
  components/core/IconButton/IconButton.test.tsx \
  components/core/Notification/Notification.test.tsx
```

DOM regressions establish name and lifecycle behavior. Browser accessibility checks
and assistive technology review remain separate evidence.

documents.title: Button family API, behavior and accessibility review
documents.markdown:
# Button family API, behavior and accessibility review

Status: API and behavior review draft. Visual and product integration approval is separate.
Reviewed: 2026-10-12. Scope: local contracts, Storybook examples, typing and jsdom regressions for Button, IconButton and TextButton.
Tokens, colors and hover/focus CSS have separate owners. This record does not approve every supported visual combination, browser behavior or screen reader.

## Criteria and authority

[Carbon Button accessibility](https://www.carbondesignsystem.com/building-blocks/core/components/button/accessibility) informs Tab/Enter/Space activation, names and hover/focus guidance for icon commands, and the distinction between commands and toggles. Carbon geometry and primary defaults are not Geul enums or defaults.
[WAI Button](https://www.w3.org/WAI/ARIA/apg/patterns/button/) distinguishes names, descriptions, pressed and expanded states;
[WAI Link](https://www.w3.org/WAI/ARIA/apg/patterns/link/) requires real href navigation semantics.
[React Aria Button](https://react-aria.adobe.com/Button) retains focus and blocks repeated activation while pending.
[React Aria Link](https://react-aria.adobe.com/Link) provides the supported render API used to preserve the actual element, DOM props and ref.

Authority: [Button](../../components/core/Button/Button.tsx), [IconButton](../../components/core/IconButton/IconButton.tsx),
[TextButton](../../components/core/TextButton/TextButton.tsx), [shared props](../../components/core/control-props.ts),
[Core specifications](core-specifications.md) and the [Geul guide](../design-system.md).
Installed versions: react-aria-components 1.22.1 / react-aria 3.53.1.

## API and actual states

| Concern              | Button                                                                    | IconButton                                                                                  | TextButton                                                                                  |
| -------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Command / navigation | Without href: button. With href: link                                     | Same; drag-handle is a native button                                                        | Same                                                                                        |
| Defaults             | neutral / medium / sm / type=button                                       | neutral / low / xs / square / action                                                        | default / sm / regular / inline-flex / type=button                                          |
| Sizes                | compact, xs, sm, md, lg, xl                                               | compact, chrome, xs–xl (controlSize removed)                                                | size/controlSize=xs, sm, md                                                                 |
| Disabled             | Native disabled; blocks activation                                        | Same; blocks drag start                                                                     | disabled only on actions                                                                    |
| Pending              | loading; busy + pending + aria-disabled; retains focus                    | Same; drag-handle uses native disabled                                                      | No loading API                                                                              |
| Form                 | type, form, name and value only on actions                                | type on actions; drag-handle only type=button                                               | type/form only on actions                                                                   |
| Navigation           | href/target/rel/download/replace/scroll/prefetch/onNavigate only on links | Same                                                                                        | Same; links allow onNavigate, not onClick/disabled                                          |
| Name                 | Visible children or an ARIA name                                          | Exactly one of label / aria-label / aria-labelledby; rejects blank or missing runtime names | Visible children or an ARIA name                                                            |
| Semantic state       | aria-pressed for toggles; owning triggers supply aria-expanded/haspopup   | Same                                                                                        | selected expresses visual ancestry; callers separately supply aria-current/expanded/pressed |
| Slots                | leftSection → label → rightSection → indicator                            | Glyph, decorative count, pending progress                                                   | Label, trailing indicator                                                                   |
| Visual escapes       | Rejects style/className/framework props and reserved state                | Same                                                                                        | Same                                                                                        |

The Button/IconButton action name stays stable through default → pending → default. The pending ProgressBar has its own name.
External aria-labelledby takes precedence; an explicit aria-label is preserved; ordinary Button refers to its visible label.
The supported render API preserves the actual button relationship so vendor pending progress does not append its name to the action.

While pending, Button changes its native type to button to block default submit/reset behavior, then restores the requested type. IconButton follows the same rule.
Unavailable Button/IconButton links render React Aria's span role=link, with aria-disabled and without a native anchor, navigation callback or tab stop. Pending links also retain aria-busy.
The vendor ref for this placeholder is not an anchor; do not use an unavailable link for imperative anchor operations.

Parent ActionRow/Toolbar/Header density can determine geometry. Shared tokens own the coarse-pointer minimum target.
Button's internal gap remains 8px with `size="compact"` or `ToolbarDensity="compact"` alone.
Only `HeaderDensityProvider density="compact"` uses the 4px `control-label-compact` role.
Storybook separately reproduces the compact-size 8px gap and HeaderDensity compact 4px gap.
Button wrap/fullWidth and TextButton nowrap/display/fullWidth combinations need actual locale and viewport review.
IconButton count is decorative; callers provide its business meaning through a name or description.
External aria-labelledby requires a nonempty ID string; callers ensure those IDs exist and provide appropriate context.

## Reproduced problems and corrections

| Problem                                         | Evidence before correction                                                                                                                 | Correction                                                                                                 |
| ----------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Loading reset cleared the form                  | New native click/onReset regression failed                                                                                                 | Button/IconButton pending type=button                                                                      |
| Disabled drag handle retained draggable=true    | New native draggable regression failed                                                                                                     | disabled/loading sets draggable=false, prevents dragstart and blocks callbacks                             |
| Nameless IconButton was accepted                | JS/dynamic spreads could render blank names despite required types                                                                         | TypeError for missing/blank/multiple name channels; regressions for valid external labels and badge naming |
| Commands without href accepted navigation props | New rejected type fixture produced TS2578                                                                                                  | Navigation props are never in the action branch; link branch rejects form/submit data                      |
| Drag handle accepted type=submit                | Rejected fixture produced TS2578                                                                                                           | Sensor type is restricted to button                                                                        |
| tabIndex=-1 was filtered                        | Installed useFocusable replaced it with default 0                                                                                          | Supported excludeFromTabOrder on actions; supported link render preserves native tabIndex                  |
| aria-busy was filtered                          | Existing ToolbarCommand pending regression failed                                                                                          | Supported render preserves actual DOM busy state                                                           |
| Pending action name was duplicated              | Browser reviewer observed button `Saving Saving` and progress `Saving` in Button Loading / Dark EN; four new exact-name regressions failed | Preserve the pending button name relationship; retain progress naming and its accessibility tree           |
| Every command example behaved as a toggle       | Three wrappers added aria-pressed and toggle callbacks to all commands                                                                     | Ordinary examples remain commands; only Toggle owns pressed state; Indicator uses a real DropdownMenu      |

Default, matrix and pressed/focus stories no longer turn Save/Delete/drag commands into persistent toggles.
Toggle keeps its label unchanged across states. CurrentLink demonstrates selected together with aria-current.

## Actual consumers

- [FormModal](../../components/core/Modal/FormModal.tsx), [ConfirmModal](../../components/core/Modal/ConfirmModal.tsx): loading submit/confirm and explicitly designated strong Dialog primary actions.
- [ToolbarCommand](../../components/core/Section/ToolbarCommand.tsx): pending names, duplicate-activation blocking, icon-only tooltip and wrapping labels.
- [ShellView](../../features/shell/ui/Shell/ShellView.tsx): selected ancestry and aria-current page links, separately from aria-expanded menu triggers.
- [FormattingButtons](../../features/editor/toolbars/FormattingButtons.tsx) and the shared [EditorToolbarAction](../../features/editor/toolbars/EditorToolbarAction.tsx): IconButton `pressed` toggles. [FileBrowserViewToggle](../../features/file-manager/ui/FileBrowserViewToggle.tsx) now uses SegmentedControl icon options.
- [TiptapBlockMenu](../../features/editor/tiptap/TiptapBlockMenu.tsx): native drag activator, tabIndex=-1 and keyboard/menu callbacks.
- [MediaTransport](../../components/core/MediaControls/MediaTransport.tsx): the current play/pause command name; icons are not universally toggles.

The common Core behavior reaches these consumers. This review did not change consumer copy, layout or emphasis.

## Executed checks and remaining scope

- Baseline: 33 tests passed in the three target files. New reset and disabled-drag regressions failed on native reset execution and draggable=true respectively.
- After correction: 65 tests passed in the three files. Coverage includes one activation per Enter/Space, pending keyboard/click blocking, focus retention/restoration, external form association, type restoration, names, count, slot order, current/pressed/expanded and action/link tabIndex.
- Types: `node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc --noEmit --project components/core/tsconfig.type-test.json` passed. Fixtures compile allowed icon names/links/form/toggles and reject navigation-branch violations, drag type, style and invalid indicators.
- Consumer runtime run: the three target files plus ToolbarCommand/PageHeader/SortableSurface/SortableGroups/NavigationLink passed, 8 files / 81 tests. Eight new exact-name cases cover visible label / explicit aria-label / external aria-labelledby before and during pending, with a separate progress name. The initial expanded run's ToolbarCommand aria-busy failure was corrected by preserving DOM busy. The command was `node node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run` followed by those eight test paths. jsdom's unimplemented external-navigation logs do not approve browser navigation.

After the final native-render explicit-type lint adjustment, Button/IconButton passed separately: 2 files / 54 tests.
ESLint `--max-warnings=0` passed for 21 changed Button/Dialog TS/TSX files.
The default `tsc --noEmit --incremental false` failed on duplicate `.next/types` / `.next/dev/types` declarations and Storybook vendor declarations. That run reported no Button/Dialog owned source/test errors. Passing Core fixtures is not a full-project build pass.

A browser reviewer observed the duplicated name at `localhost:6012`, Button Loading / Dark EN.
The saved post-correction Dark EN observation (2026-10-11 17:12:49.698 UTC) records one action name `Saving`, a separate ProgressBar name `Saving`, and action aria-busy=true.
Check the current Button stories and exact accessible-name regressions in `Button.test.tsx`.
No complete AX tree is attached. The observation lacks a source SHA, so its identity with current source is unverified.
The 1425×891px image differs from the recorded 1440×900px DOM viewport and is not a complete viewport visual pass.
The reviewing agent organized saved evidence and did not operate a browser.
These DOM name regressions do not approve pending live-announcer order or messages. Exact-name checks cover action buttons; pending-link span names still need browser review. Existing unavailable-link regressions verify navigation/callback/tab-stop blocking.

The reviewing agent did not execute browser checks for light/dark, locales, mobile/tablet/desktop, long-label reflow/ellipsis, hover/focus/pressed/disabled/pending combinations, touch targets or reduced motion. VoiceOver/Orca were not run. Carbon's passing results are not Geul passing results.
IconButton does not automatically create a tooltip; compositions such as ToolbarCommand must explicitly provide visual guidance. Standalone icon-only consumers still need hover/focus tooltip review. Whether aria-label preserves visible labels requires consumer review with translation and business context.

## Review baseline SHA-256

Dirty files were copied and hashed at the start. A git diff containing earlier edits does not isolate this review.
The scoped diff is `/tmp/geul-button-review.patch`; original copies are `/tmp/geul-button-review-before/`.
